metadata.description: Threadlight pilot pipeline — 23 pipeline skills + threadlight-auto agent-guided lifecycle planner (24 total), including optional per-agent AgentOps evidence. Takes a customer engagement from brief to a working pilot with selected runtime governance and an evidence-backed path to production. Per-binding evidence, not whole-agent certification. Includes an optional GitHub Copilot App Lifecycle Canvas.
